translation: Bahaatti immoo bantii kaabaatti jiraatanii, hanga seenu bishaan-lafaa (madda) dhufuutti, naannoo lagaa Peraat, sababa inni waraanni isaanii biqatuuf daandii bulchiinsaa naannoo dhumaatti, sababa meeqqaan loon isaanii biqate biyya Giil'aditti. Naannoo lafa Giil'ad keessatti sababa loon isaanii baay'ee waan ta'eef.
